note: Individual justifications for reachable methods that the offline port cannot execute. Each rule names types or methods (IL ledger ids, regex on 'type::method') and the reason. Applied by tools/callgraph/analyze.py; justified methods stay counted among the reachable and are listed apart with the reason. Source: docs/notes/coverage-situations.md.

rules.reason: Offline port: these screens are only opened from paths removed by policy (GameBanner.Draw draws nothing, so its touch target never exists; SurfaceManager.UpdateAdMobView, the only creator of KairoService, is a policy; billing provisioning is disabled; friend/lineup need KairoService).

SpForm (support/upload) opens only with key 0x800 held at a crash or boot error, or holding gamepad component 5 for 5 s in pad mode 0, which the port surface never uses; its Run uploads to the support server (network).
HttpForm is created only when the language panel returns -1/-2 (download of an online language pack); the offline language presenter never returns those values.
Hidden title commands need keys 2/1024/2048 (STAR), which no Android touch device produces, and they send data to the network.
Dead in the original: SoccerForm states 1 and 15 are set only by debug code; GameForm.selectTenantData_ is never assigned.
Static-analysis over-approximation: the analysis assumes the runtime may call ToString/GetHashCode/Equals on every instantiated type; no game path calls them on these types.
